about.title: About Balance Transfer Calculator - Credit Card Debt Management Tool
about.description: The Balance Transfer Calculator is a debt planning tool designed to help you evaluate the potential impact of transferring credit card balances to lower-interest cards. Whether you're looking to consolidate multiple credit card debts or review promotional 0% APR offers, this calculator shows possible interest savings and helps you compare payoff scenarios. Understanding balance transfer calculations can support debt planning and help you estimate whether transfer fees may be offset by lower interest charges.

howTo.title: How to Use the Balance Transfer Calculator

faq.q: When does a balance transfer make sense?
faq.a: Balance transfers make sense when you can secure a significantly lower interest rate, especially 0% promotional rates, and you have a plan to pay off the debt during the promotional period. The savings should outweigh transfer fees and you should avoid accumulating new debt.

faq.q: What are typical balance transfer fees?
faq.a: Balance transfer fees typically range from 3-5% of the transferred amount, with a minimum fee of $5-10. Some cards offer promotional periods with no transfer fees, but these are less common. Factor these fees into your savings calculations.

faq.q: How long do promotional 0% APR periods last?
faq.a: Promotional 0% APR periods typically last 12-21 months, with some extending to 24 months. After the promotional period ends, the rate increases to the card's regular APR, which can be 15-25% or higher.

faq.q: Will a balance transfer affect my credit score?
faq.a: Balance transfers can temporarily lower your credit score due to hard inquiries and new account openings. However, they can improve your score long-term by reducing credit utilization ratios and helping you pay down debt faster.
